professionalSummary.text: Data scientist with experience building and maintaining features for a weekly SKU-level demand-forecasting model at Brightwater Beverages from January 2020 to April 2024, working within a five-person analytics team.
professionalSummary.witness: Data analyst, then data scientist, at Brightwater Beverages from January 2020 to April 2024, in a demand-planning analytics team of five.

experienceHighlights.text: Built promotional-uplift features (discount depth, display flags, competitor promotions) for the weekly SKU-level forecasting model and maintained them as a scheduled Airflow pipeline.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built the promotional-uplift features (discount depth, display flags, competitor promotions) for the weekly SKU-level forecasting model and kept them running as a scheduled Airflow pipeline.

experienceHighlights.text: Ran monthly backtests of the gradient-boosted forecasting model and documented results for the lead data scientist, who decided on model changes.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran the monthly backtests of the gradient-boosted forecasting model and wrote up the results for the lead data scientist, who decided which model changes went forward.

experienceHighlights.text: Presented monthly forecast-accuracy reviews to the supply-planning team, breaking down bias and error by product category and channel, and agreed on actions with planners.
experienceHighlights.witness: Presented the monthly forecast-accuracy review to the supply-planning team, with bias and error broken down by product category and channel, and the actions agreed with the planners.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented input-data and known-limitations sections of the forecasting model's model card following the team's documentation template.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the input-data and known-limitations sections of the forecasting model's model card, following the team's documentation template.
